headline: Cisco (CSCO) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After AI Networking Order Strength
summary: Cisco Systems now carries a slightly higher assessed fair value, with the price target moving from US$127.05 to US$130.23. Recent Street research links this change to higher fair value estimates tied to AI infrastructure demand, networking order strength and management guidance on future AI related revenue, while still flagging pockets of risk.
